findings.evidence: ReductiveGroups/README.md Layer 9 orders split reductive group schemes and pinnings before all-root subgroup maps; lines 35–37 of this file disclaim reductivity, a Borel/full pinning, and all-root subgroups, while the existing E6 Minuscule/RootDatum.lean already establishes the same peripheral interface pattern.
findings.fix: Defer these rewrites until the E₇ carrier is proved split reductive and assembled with its Borel/full pinning, or include them in a PR that advances one of those missing stages.
findings.issue: The cited Layer 9 targets presuppose a split reductive group scheme with a Borel/full pinning and root subgroups for every root, while this module expressly supplies none of those and therefore does not move the target itself materially closer.

summary: This is a genuine Layer 9 prerequisite, but it adds another character-interface satellite before the E₇ carrier has the earlier structure required for the cited pinning and root-subgroup targets.
